About the PPH End Cap, Socket / Butt Weld

An end cap seals the end of a line, either permanently or for pressure testing before the line is extended.

About PPH Fittings

PPH fittings are used in chemical process, pickling and plating lines, fume scrubbing and effluent systems where higher chemical and temperature resistance than HDPE is needed. Socket-weld and butt-weld types are available in most sizes.
